# r4.0

- The synchronization arrows in workspace tabs and the lower-left status summary are now horizontally mirrored. Their size, position, colors and status behavior remain unchanged.
- This is the stable r4.0 release following pre.12. It includes the preceding r4.0 prerelease changes, including synchronization improvements and the startup/disconnected-tab passphrase focus fix.

Published as the stable Latest release using the existing registered signing key and signed updater. No synchronization, connection, installation or update policy is changed by this final icon adjustment.
